newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-2 MIM execs resign after restructure.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-2 MIM execs resign after restructure.

text.p: Mining group MIM Holdings Ltd said on Friday two senior executives had resigned because their jobs no longer existed after a restructure of the group's divisions.
An MIM spokesman told Reuters Geoff Billard, general manager of metals, and Ross Fardon, exploration manager, had resigned after the restructure.
"There's been a logical extension of the restructuring that's taken place in the last couple of years," the MIM spokesman said.

MIM's push for much closer linking of its production sources to its customers meant there was now no need for an executive general manager of metals as those functions were now assumed by the Mount Isa Metals manager, the spokesman said.
"He (Billard) leaves with the appreciation of the company for the job that he did," the spokesman said.
The restructuring also meant that the exploration and gold divisions had been brought under the umbrella of the development division, meaning there was no need for an exploration manager.
"That job has effectively gone and Ross has resigned because he appreciated that position," the spokesman said.
